summary: Verified BridgeBot Scripted Mode v3 — AI Conversation Router. Backend pytest 30/34 passing (88%); 4 failures are real implementation gaps in _ai_pick_variant() input parser and manual-mode msg3+ silence semantics (see backend_issues). Frontend 8/8 verified: Acknowledgment Replies block (data-testid='scripted-acks-block') correctly hides on rephrase_mode='manual' and shows on 'ai'/'hybrid'; all 4 defaults pre-fill scripted-ack-0..3; Add/Delete row buttons work; Update Message hint matches spec verbatim. Auto-seeding of acknowledgment_replies on GET /api/discord/config works for both missing field and explicit empty list; custom acks persist without override.

minor.issue: Parser uses `.strip().split()[0]` then digit filter, so 'option 2' → '' → 0 (expected 2) and 'Pick: 1' → '' → 0 (expected 1). Spec in review_request explicitly lists 'option 2' as a required parseable input.
'-1' is accepted as 1 because digit-only filter strips the negative sign. Should return 0 (out-of-range). Fix: parse signed int via regex `re.search(r'-?\d+', token)` then range check.

rephrase_mode='manual' at count==2 returns `fallback_message` (line ~638) instead of staying silent. Review spec test (1) says manual mode msg3+ should be '' silent. However, *no* LLM call is made — the cost-zero contract is honoured. Decide: keep one-shot fallback at msg3 (current) or fully silent (spec). Recommend documenting intent.

action_items: Fix _ai_pick_variant parser to handle 'option N' / 'Pick: N' patterns (scan entire string for first integer, not just first token).
Fix _ai_pick_variant to reject negative integers (currently '-1' returns 1).
Clarify manual-mode msg3+ behavior: spec says silent, code returns fallback once at count==2. Either update spec/test or change code path.
critical_code_review_comments: _ai_pick_variant could be made more robust with a single regex: `m = re.search(r'(-?\d+)', out or ''); idx = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0;` then 1<=idx<=len(options) check. Current `.split()[0]` discards multi-word LLM outputs that are otherwise easy to recover.

build_scripted_response is now ~150 lines — consider extracting the msg3+ AI router into its own helper `_route_msg3_plus(intent, variants, ack_replies, fallback, ...)` for unit-testability without DB seeding.

Frontend Rephrase Mode is rendered as 3 button cards (testids scripted-mode-{ai,hybrid,manual}), NOT a <select>. Acceptable, but tests/docs that assume select-element semantics will mislead future iterations.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed db.scripted_counters with TEST_ prefixed instance/channel/user ids and count=2 to land directly in the msg3+ branch on next message. Fixture teardown deletes them. Discord config GET/PUT tests mutate the real Scripted Test instance's scripted_mode.acknowledgment_replies field. Left in 'ai' mode with primary_message='PRIMARY TEST' and seeded default acks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://rag-search-dev.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_scripted_ai_router.py -v`. The 4 failing tests are intentional — they document spec gaps. After main agent fixes the parser and clarifies manual-mode behavior, they should all pass. UI testids on /admin/discord: scripted-mode-toggle (button role=switch), scripted-mode-{ai|hybrid|manual} (button cards, NOT a select), scripted-acks-block, scripted-ack-N, scripted-ack-del-N, scripted-add-ack. To force-enable Scripted Mode without the toggle (which sometimes fails to click in headless), PUT /api/discord/config with {scripted_mode: {enabled: true, rephrase_mode: 'ai', primary_message: '...'}}.
rca of the issue: Two implementation bugs in _ai_pick_variant: (1) `.split()[0]` discards everything after the first whitespace token, so 'option 2' becomes 'option' which has no digits; (2) the digit-only character filter strips '-' allowing '-1' to become '1'. Both can be fixed by replacing the two-step strip/filter with a single regex search for an optional-sign integer. The manual-mode msg3+ behavior is a spec/implementation mismatch — code intentionally sends fallback once at count==2 then goes silent (matches the inline comment 'Past 2nd message in manual mode — silent (or send fallback once)'), but review_request spec says it should be silent from msg3+. Cost-zero LLM contract is satisfied either way.
